title: Attackers Reportedly Deployed Simulated AI Support Chatbot to Trick Instagram Business Users into Adding Malicious 2FA Login

behaviors.text: It remains unclear whether the chatbot used AI or was human-operated via a bot-like interface.
A phishing campaign has reportedly been impersonating Meta support using a fake chatbot interface to hijack Instagram Business accounts.
There, a simulated chatbot instructed users to add the attacker’s Authenticator app as a secure login method, enabling account takeover.
